title: Associate Cloud Engineer I
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Associate Cloud Engineer I will help support, design, and deliver technical solutions that keep AbbVie’s business platforms running effectively and evolving to meet business needs. This role is expected to troubleshoot and resolve platform issues, partner with business and IT teams to deliver enhancements and integrations, improve platform performance, scalability, and reliability, support project delivery, maintain technical documentation, and help manage risk, cybersecurity, and data protection requirements.
Responsibilities
Troubleshoot technical issues and resolve incidents to maintain stable business platforms.
Partner with business and IT teams to design and deliver platform enhancements and integrations.
Support continuous improvement of platform performance, scalability, reliability, and overall functionality.
Track project milestones, coordinate across teams, and support the successful and timely delivery of technical solutions.
Maintain required technical documentation and support testing, deployment, and other activities throughout the solution lifecycle.
Assess technical and operational risks and partner with business, vendor, and technical teams to support cybersecurity and data protection requirements.
Escalate issues to ensure execution success and keep stakeholders informed through effective verbal and written communication.
Learn, understand, and master new methods and technologies, and act as a resource or mentor for others.
Adhere to corporate standards regarding applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies, including code of conduct, safety, GxP compliance, data security, and the software development lifecycle.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or relevant field.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and DevOps tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, CI/CD)
Working knowledge of architecture and how structure and solutions fit together
Previous internship or related experience in cloud engineering
Technical and business insight, strong analytical skills, and creative problem-solving abilities
Proven track record of teamwork, adaptability, innovation, initiative, and integrity
Excellent communication, leadership, and project management skills
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with low-code platforms (Pega, OutSystems) and troubleshooting/configuring platforms such as ServiceNow, UKG Pro WFM, or Workday Time Tracking/Absence
Experience with XML, XSLT, WebServices, and Dell Boomi
Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML in clinical or pharmaceutical contexts

title: Associate Director, AMI Curricula
description:
About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/ . Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
The Associate Director of AMI Curricula is responsible for the development of curricula across Allergan Medical Institute educational programs, primarily new large group programs in-field and in the Training Centers. Main responsibilities include collaboration with key stakeholders (AMI Programs team, Customer Marketing teams, Training Centers team, Design & Internal review team, etc) to develop content to achieve our educational objectives across the HCP learning journey.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following (other duties may be assigned.):
Lead the development of AMI curricula across all large group programming in the AMI Training Centers and in-field programming
Strategic oversight of AMI content and tactics as it relates to large group programs, including: Net new program creation based on Learning Journey, business needs, market demand
Go to market strategy for new programs through Field and digital channels
Strategy for Faculty speaker training and selection, ongoing Faculty training post-launch
Oversight of development of all training materials, videos, slide decks, etc, aligning to brand strategy, KOL review, and adult learning principles
Curricula Lead for all internal Sales communications, including: Liaison between Curricula and Faculty Development team
Coordination of any new initiatives with Commercial Directors
Development of Field Resources (sales aids, targeting tools, etc)
Management of agency partners and content designers to ensure content adheres to creative and curricula briefs, brand guidelines, and MLRC review guidelines
Management of ‘Large Group/Training Center AMI pillar’ team members
Oversight of all workshop and agenda development
Responsible for capturing KOL advisor feedback across all programs
Translating key strategic initiatives into plans and go-to-market tactics for new AMI engagement programs
Coordinating cross-functional internal resources and third parties/vendors for the execution of AMI Engagement initiatives
Building and maintaining strong relationships with KOLs, thought leaders, and other key stakeholders
Coordinating with, and training HCP partners to ensure the execution of successful training programs
Perform other duties as assigned
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent is required.
Minimum of 10 years related experience is preferred.
Experience in curricula development
Experience on product/indication launches
Experience managing a team
Proficient with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
Knowledge of FDA and regulatory statutes as applied to Allergan Aesthetics products, with the ability to function in an environment controlled by outside regulatory entities.
Knowledge of procedure training, consultation, business-to business (B2B) and selling skills are desired.
High degree of flexibility in adapting to a rapidly changing environment.
Occasional flexibility in work hours, including weekends, may be required.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Additional Requirements:
Ability to travel up to 40%. Evenings, overnight, weekends, domestic is required.
Language and Verbal Skills:
Individual must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
Analytical and Reading Skills:
Ability to read, understand and abide by company procedures. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions and report on findings.

title: Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs US Advertising and Promotion - Immunology
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The  Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs US Advertising and Promotion - Immunology  is responsible for setting strategy and leading cross-functional, multidisciplinary, therapeutic teams, and executes multidivisional initiatives. The Associate Director envisions the future by using global marketplace, technology and business knowledge, collects and analyzes issues and trends that affect the business. This individual identifies and acts upon cross-organization or cross-business opportunities and possesses and leverages broad industry knowledge.
Responsibilities:
Make decisions and plans for operations (workflow, assignments, staff development) within area of responsibility with minimal direction. Sets strategy and leads cross-functional/multidisciplinary therapeutic teams and multidivisional initiatives.
Maintains and evaluates productivity metrics to project current and future business needs
Aligns and maintains effective communication channels with key Medical, Marketing, Regulatory, Legal and Public Affairs counterparts. Identifies areas of improvement in process/policy, develops recommendations/plan, and leads initiatives.
Assists in the management of the departmental budget, identifies and communicates budgetary needs to Operations and Finance, and identifies and projects current and future expenditures and business needs.
Collects and analyzes issues/trends that affect business to identify and act on cross-organization or cross business opportunities. Effective use of knowledge of global marketplace, technology and business levels.
Operates independently, with recognition of when to consult departmental senior concerning risks. In absence of Director, is responsible for day-to-day operations. Responsible for departmental initiatives, which have significant impact on both internal and external customers.
Encourages innovation and holds employees accountable for delivering on their goals; recognizes, mentors, rewards and recommends promotion for staff members based on their performance, results, and development.
Exhibits solid understanding of regulations, and guidance of regulatory authorities, political and legal climate and industry practices related to advertising and promotions to assist in meeting organizational goals. Possesses and leverages broad industry knowledge
Develops and implements complex processes and projects and develops and delivers strategic presentations for senior management
Identifies areas of improvement in process, policy, develops recommendations/plan and leads initiatives
This role will work a hybrid work schedule (3 days in office, 2 days remotely) from our Mettawa, IL; Florham Park, NJ or Irvine, CA AbbVie headquarters.
Significant Work Activities: Continuous sitting for prolonged periods (more than 2 consecutive hours in an 8 hr day) is required
Minimum bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in science (biology, chemistry, microbiology, immunology, medical technology, pharmacy, pharmacology), is required. Master’s, Ph.D or Pharm D preferred.
You should also possess: Associate Director: 8+ years of pharmaceutical experience with a Bachelor's, 5+ years with a Pharm D plus relevant ad promo experience
The candidate must have a solid understanding of regulatory advertising and promotion regulations, having had direct responsibility in this area.
Experience working in a complex and matrix environment
Strong communication skills, both oral and written
Experience in management capacity preferred

title: Maintenance Optimization TPM, Availability Serviceability Team
description:
The AWS Data Center Availability Serviceability team works with hundreds of AWS data centers globally to deliver the highest quality and lowest cost availability, capacity, and scaling results for our customers. We standardize operations globally by delivering tools, policy, processes, and procedures to our internal teams.
Serviceability is the ability to maintain, repair, and manage infrastructure assets efficiently throughout their lifecycle -- encompassing maintenance standards, spares management, training and certifications, operational readiness, and the systematic use of data and automation to prevent disruptions and drive continuous improvement.
We are seeking a Maintenance Optimization Technical Program Manager to own how AWS data center infrastructure is maintained: which tasks, at what interval, with what controls, and why. The fleet runs thousands of preventive maintenance plans inherited from vendor manuals and historical practice. This role applies reliability-centered maintenance thinking to that inventory at fleet scale, deciding what each task protects against, whether the control fits the failure mode and its consequence, and where a human check can be replaced by telemetry or retired altogether.
Key job responsibilities
You will lead preventive maintenance optimization across equipment classes (electrical and mechanical), taking each change from failure-mode analysis through a revised maintenance standard to the published procedures technicians execute, with the labor and risk impact quantified. You will set the method: a repeatable, lightweight way to challenge a maintenance task (failure mode, consequence, existing detection, proposed control) that program managers across the team can run without you. Working with our monitoring, controls, and maintenance-planning teams, you will drive decisions on where remote telemetry can replace a physical inspection, removing a human check only when the data demonstrably covers it.
You will own decisions that most maintenance organizations never revisit. The problem is real engineering, not process administration: you will be asked why a task exists, what happens if it stops, and whether the data can prove it. You will work across EAM data, equipment telemetry, regulatory regimes, vendor warranty terms, and the physical gear itself, and you will do it inside the constraints of a live production fleet where being wrong has consequences. And you will build the capability in others. The TPMs you coach will carry this reasoning into every program they touch.
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Preferred qualifications: - 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience applying reliability-centered maintenance methods (FMEA, task selection by failure mode and consequence, condition-based alternatives to calendar PMs) to a live fleet, including defending a change to an established maintenance standard.

Excellent collaborative skills.

title: Data Scientist - Intelligent Experiences, MLO
description:
Do you believe machine learning and AI can change the world? We do. We're the ML Data team within Apple's Intelligent System Experience (ISE) group, and we build the high-quality, high-scale datasets that train the ML features across many Apple products — iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Our work sits behind some of the most visible and personal experiences Apple ships: the wallpaper on your Lock Screen, personalized stickers in iMessage, on-device Genmoji and other Apple Intelligence generative models, and models that recognize faces and build memories of the people you love in Photos.
We're looking for a data scientist who's passionate about ML data and excited to shape the training data behind Apple's next generation of multi-modal features. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings rigorous scientific reasoning and owns problems end-to-end.
Join us and you’ll shape shipping products from your first week, working with petabytes of multi-modal data.
You will design and operate the end-to-end data lifecycle that supports training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of large language models and diffusion models. Day to day, that means building distributed pipelines that clean, deduplicate, and enrich massive multi-modal datasets; standing up synthetic data generation pipelines with LLM-based generators, validators, and judges; and engineering agentic workflows — multi-step, tool-using LLM systems — that scale human judgment across far more data than a human team could review directly.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related engineering field
5+ years of hands-on experience applying NLP, computer vision, or multimodal machine learning to production systems, including experience with large-scale data pipelines
Preferred qualifications: Experience prompting, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs or vision-language/diffusion models for specific downstream tasks
Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), preference optimization (RLHF, DPO), RAG and retrieval-based data curation
Experience designing, evaluating and productionizing data science algorithms used for data curation, data filtering, deduplication and data down-selection.
Experience designing controlled experiments or ablation studies to understand effect of data on model quality
Experience building agentic or multi-agent, tool-using LLM systems and human-in-the-loop workflows, calibrating judges against human labels, and mitigating failure modes
Strong software engineering skills, with 5+ years in Python, workflow orchestration (Airflow), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Ray, or similar) at large scale
Publication record or open-source contributions in NLP, computer vision, or generative AI is a plus

title: Digital Mixed-Signal Modeling Engineer
description:
Imagine what you could do here at Apple! Together we could help craft the next generation of the world’s finest devices. The right candidate will thrive in that type of environment. You will work with us from Apple's headquarters in Cupertino, California. It's one of the most exciting aspects of the job. Dynamic, smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.
Will you help us design the next generation of revolutionary Apple products?
As a member of the digital mixed-signal modeling team, you’ll play a crucial role in developing behavioral models to verify wireless SoCs. Your support will be essential for multiple pre-silicon validation teams to ensure a fully functional first silicon.

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Experience in writing scripts in languages such as Perl or Python.

Good understanding of AMS and wireless circuits/systems.
Experience with SystemC modeling and high-level synthesis.

title: Engineering Leader, AI Safety Engineering & Evaluation, Apple Services Engineering
description:
Apple Services Engineering (ASE) powers AI and machine learning experiences across the App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV, and more. We build intelligent, deeply personal experiences designed to serve users around the world. Ensuring these experiences are safe, trustworthy, and representative of the diverse communities we serve is fundamental to how we develop and deploy AI.
We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to lead AI Safety Engineering & Evaluation within the Human-Centered AI organization. This role combines software engineering, machine learning, evaluation science, and Responsible AI to develop scalable capabilities for identifying, measuring, and mitigating risks associated with AI-powered experiences.
You will lead an emerging, multidisciplinary organization of engineering managers, engineers, and applied scientists, building the technical expertise, engineering practices, and organizational capabilities needed to scale AI safety evaluation. This is an opportunity to shape a growing function, developing its technical foundations while transforming manual safety assessments into automated, scientifically rigorous processes.
The ideal candidate brings strong engineering leadership, practical expertise in machine learning and modern AI systems, and demonstrated success building technical organizations and translating complex challenges into measurable engineering outcomes.
As the Engineering Leader for AI Safety Engineering & Evaluation, you will lead the development and operationalization of technical capabilities to systematically assess AI model behavior, identify potential harms, and measure the effectiveness of safety mitigations.
Your organization will advance safety evaluation methodologies, model-based assessment, adversarial testing, automated risk identification, and failure analysis. In partnership with Evaluation Systems & Research (ESR), which provides shared evaluation infrastructure and services, you will integrate safety-specific models, assessment workflows, and measurement capabilities into scalable evaluation systems.
You will establish the technical direction, organizational structure, and engineering practices needed for a growing team to operate effectively. This requires a leader who can engage deeply in technical decisions, develop engineering managers and senior contributors, and progressively build the organization's ability to deliver complex technical solutions.
You will work closely with machine learning engineering, research, product, privacy, legal, and safety policy teams to translate safety requirements into measurable technical standards and actionable insights that inform AI development and deployment decisions.
Minimum qualifications: 12+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, applied AI, or related technical disciplines, including demonstrated experience delivering complex production-quality systems.
8+ years of engineering or applied machine learning management experience, including at least 3 years managing engineering managers or leading multiple technical teams through established managers.
Demonstrated experience building or transforming engineering organizations, including developing technical talent, establishing engineering practices, and scaling teams through periods of organizational or technical growth.
Strong software engineering foundation, including experience guiding architecture, implementation, and operationalization of complex software or AI/ML solutions.
Practical expertise in machine learning and modern AI architectures, including model development, inference, and evaluation methodologies.
Strong technical foundation in Python and modern software development practices, with the ability to assess technical tradeoffs and guide engineering execution.
Demonstrated ability to develop technical roadmaps, establish priorities, manage resources, and deliver measurable outcomes in ambiguous environments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior technical and cross-functional leaders.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred qualifications: Experience leading teams developing AI/ML evaluation systems, automated model assessment, or applied machine learning solutions.
Experience with generative AI and large language models, including LLM-based evaluation, agentic systems, model orchestration, or adversarial testing.
Applied experience with machine learning modeling, statistical analysis, experimental design, and quantitative evaluation methods.
Experience developing automated model assessors, synthetic data generation, red teaming, or systematic failure analysis capabilities.
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles and technical approaches to fairness, bias, robustness, harmful content, and safety risk assessment.
Experience integrating evaluation capabilities into existing engineering platforms, development workflows, or continuous measurement processes.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through technical transformation, particularly involving automation or applied machine learning.
Ability to translate emerging research techniques into reliable engineering implementations.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline.

title: Hardware Design Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for taking on big challenges? Do you love pushing the limits of what’s considered feasible? As part of our Wireless Hardware group, you’ll be responsible for bringing groundbreaking wireless connectivity to the world. On this team, you’ll help improve the performance of our products through innovative system-on-chip designs. You and your team will build platform architecture that paves the way for all-new experiences, including the ones that allow people to take advantage of our innovations. Together, our goal is to ensure nothing stands in the way of our customers’ connections with their devices. Join us and help build world-renowned wireless systems that connect customers to their world like never before.

We support WiFi, Bluetooth, UWB, NFC, and emerging technologies across all Apple products. The Hardware Design Engineering role sits at the intersection of wireless silicon, and the rest of the SoCs in our products. You will be responsible for the end-to-end hardware design lifecycle of wireless subsystems — from architecture definition and schematic design through bring-up, characterization, and production validation. You will work closely with internal silicon, software, and platform teams as well as external chipset vendors to integrate wireless SoCs into Apple products. The role requires a strong foundation in digital interfaces, power distribution networks, firmware and system-level debug. Good understanding of protocol specifications for communication interfaces like PCIe, MIPI, I2C, SPI, UART etc.
Experience with power supply/power management and power distribution networks
Hands on debug experience with usage of modern lab equipment (DSOs, Logic Analyzers, Protocol Analyzers)
Preferred qualifications: MSEE preferred with 2+ years of relevant experience
Experience in writing basic software routines and test scripts
Experience with mobile and/or embedded processors and memory systems
Experience with circuit schematic capture/layout
Strong desire to investigate system level issues and drive problems to closure in a team-based environment with a proactive demeanor
Successful track record of delivering highly innovative communication products

description:

title: Pre-silicon Compute and ML Framework Manager
description:
Every iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Apple TV runs on the compute and graphics software foundation built by Apple’s Graphics, Games, and Machine Learning team. The Pre-silicon Compute Frameworks team sits at the leading edge of that work designing the Metal and Metal compute frameworks and validating performance for features that will define future Apple Silicon GPUs.
We’re looking for an engineering manager with a strong technical background who’s excited to build and lead a team of engineers, and to partner with software and hardware leaders to shape Apple's GPU compute roadmap!
As manager of the Pre-silicon Compute Frameworks team, you own the new APIs for Apple’s next GPU generations. You will lead, support, and grow a team of engineers building Metal and Metal compute framework features and conducting performance analysis on next generation GPU hardware, carrying features from emulation all the way through silicon and into the bring-up of new chips and products.
You will partner directly with leaders across Apple’s software and hardware organizations to propose, develop, and evaluate features for new silicon generations, representing Apple’s compute and ML roadmap while the hardware is still taking shape.

2-3 years of experience as a manager or lead
Experience with at least one GPU compute API (Metal, CUDA, OpenCL, or similar)

title: Principal AI & Data Governance Architect
description:
At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We are building the machine learning lifecycle platform that powers generative AI features across Apple Services — from Music and TV+ to iCloud, App Store, and Sports. As these systems grow in scale and complexity, building them responsibly is as important as building them well.
We are looking for a AI & Data Governance Architect who can define and drive the governance and compliance architecture for our AI and ML platform — holistically, not piecemeal. This is not a role about enforcing rules from the sidelines. It is about getting deep into how data flows, how models are built, how systems interconnect, and designing the platform capabilities that ensure Apple meets its legal, regulatory, and ethical obligations at every layer. You will be the person who understands both the compliance landscape and the engineering reality — and who builds the bridge between them.

Deep understanding of ML workflows, data engineering, and ML infrastructure — drive and provide feedback in design and architectural discussions.
Proven track record of working cross-functionally with legal, privacy, compliance, and engineering teams to define and implement governance solutions.

Exceptional ability to operate in ambiguity — connecting requirements that don't come pre-connected, and driving clarity across organizations with different vocabularies and priorities.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Strategic Risk
description:

title: Senior Security Software Engineer, Datacenter Infrastructure Security
description:
We are the Foundational Security team in Apple Services Engineering (ASE). We secure the low-level foundations of Apple's datacenter fleet: hardware-backed trust, disk encryption, and the systems used to manage every server below the operating system.
We're looking for a senior engineer to take technical ownership of the platform that manages our baseboard management controllers. You'll set its engineering and security bar, shape how access is granted and verified, and lead its move toward modern, standards-based management. You'll work closely with datacenter operations, SRE, hardware, network and detection teams, and become the go-to expert on managing Apple's fleet securely.
This role owns the design, code and security of a privileged, availability-critical service. You'll write and review production code. You'll find and remove risk in how the service authenticates users, authorizes them and handles credentials, and you'll make privileged activity visible to the teams who detect misuse. You'll also help modernize how the fleet is managed, bringing along the many internal teams and tools that depend on the platform.
Over time, you'll help define what secure out-of-band management looks like at Apple. title: Environmental Health & Safety Professional
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base is seeking a EH&S Professional to support our field operations teams in Texas. As an EHS Professional, you will perform hazard assessments, incident investigations, work through employees’ safety concerns and issues, as well as strategize with site leaders to prevent/reduce injuries. In addition, you will ensure environmental compliance with all local, state, and federal regulatory requirements applicable to these departments.

What You’ll Do

 - Develop and maintain compliance with all applicable regulations and/or guidelines established by Texas Health and Safety Codes, OSHA, NFPA, NIOSH

 - Collaborate with department leadership to complete job hazard assessments and implement health and safety policies and procedures

 - Execute industrial hygiene studies to analyze manufacturing byproducts against associated human health thresholds

 - Inspect facilities, machinery, and safety equipment in order to identify and correct potential hazards, and implement machine guarding when needed

 - Complete and maintain documented safety observations from regular hazard identification audits

 - Investigate industrial accidents, injuries, or occupational diseases to determine root causes, corrective actions and preventive measures

 - Develop safety solutions to resolve EHS hazards/ concerns within cost and schedule constraints following a safety order of precedence to include elimination, substitution, engineering controls, work practice controls, training, and personal protective equipment (PPE) to ensure that safety of personnel, property, and the environment are within acceptable risk boundaries

 - Responsible for hazardous and non-hazardous waste management


What You’ll Bring

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering with an emphasis in occupational health and safety and/or environmental engineering

 - 3+ years of experience in the design, development and operational oversight of environmental, health and safety disciplines

 - Demonstrated ability to research and apply the best industrial and working practices to provide effective services

 - Knowledge of process safety management methods, pressure systems, and chemical delivery systems

 - Strong knowledge and experience in interpreting, applying and documenting federal, state and local safety and environmental regulations

 - Experience with emergency response communication and incident management in incidents involving hazardous and non-hazardous material releases to air, soil, and water


About the Team
The Environmental Health & Safety team is responsible for building and maintaining a culture where safety is embedded into every aspect of our operations. We partner closely with field, warehouse, manufacturing, and leadership teams to proactively identify risks, implement practical safety solutions, and ensure compliance across a rapidly growing operation.

As Base continues to scale, the EHS team plays a critical role in protecting our employees, customers, and communities while enabling the business to move quickly and efficiently. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on team that values ownership, continuous improvement, and a proactive approach to solving complex safety and environmental challenges. If you're excited about building programs from the ground up, influencing operational excellence, and making a tangible impact on employee safety, you'll thrive here.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

description:
About the Team
The New Vertical Onboarding Strategy & Operations team drives a fast, seamless onboarding experience for merchants across the SMB segments. We collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to enhance visibility, streamline workflows, and reduce onboarding friction through scalable process and product improvements. Our mission is to ensure every merchant launches smoothly and efficiently, powered by data-driven insights and strong operational alignment.
About the Role
The SMB Onboarding Strategy & Operations (S&O) role focuses on improving the end-to-end onboarding experience for small and medium-sized merchants by identifying process inefficiencies, building visibility tools, and driving scalable solutions across cross-functional teams. This role acts as the single-threaded owner for SMB onboarding, ensuring merchants are launched quickly, accurately, and with minimal friction through data-driven insights, process automation, and clear ownership alignment.
Key Responsibilities
Process Visibility & SLA Tracking: Build dashboards to monitor true onboarding timelines, identify delays, and surface insights to inform process and tooling improvements.
Root Causing Blocked Cases: Develop a shared tracker for blocked cases, analyze trends, and work with cross-functional partners to resolve issues and implement sustainable fixes.
Integrations Enablement: Design and refine onboarding workflows for new integration types (e.g., Shopify), and establish scalable processes as SMB Retail expands in 2026.
Product & Tooling Guidance: Translate workflow gaps into actionable product requirements for systems like SFDC, and advocate for automation that reduces manual work.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with MXO, GTMT, IA, Sales, and Product to ensure end-to-end alignment on onboarding priorities and execution.
Data & Insights: Create and maintain onboarding performance dashboards to measure success and track progress toward SLAs and OKRs.
You will report into the Manager of the Onboarding S&O pod on our Merchant Onboarding & Experience S&O team in our New Verticals Business Development organization.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Drive meaningful impact by transforming how SMB merchants onboard — reducing friction, accelerating launch timelines, and improving the overall merchant experience.
Shape strategy and process from the ground up, building visibility tools, performance metrics, and scalable workflows that become the foundation for SMB onboarding excellence.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Ops, and GTMT to design solutions that balance speed, quality, and automation across the onboarding journey.
Own high-visibility problem areas, using data to identify blockers and lead systemic, cross-team improvements that directly impact business growth.
Be at the forefront of innovation, helping define the future of merchant onboarding as new integrations, verticals, and tooling capabilities are unlocked in 2026 and beyond
We’re excited about you because…
You have 2+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment, where you’ve built and optimized processes from the ground up.
You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable using data to uncover insights, measure impact, and inform operational or strategic decisions.
You thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, adapting quickly while maintaining a high bar for execution and detail.
You’re a strong cross-functional collaborator.
You’re known for your ability to “herd cats” — driving accountability, clarifying ownership, and keeping complex projects on track amid competing priorities.
You possess a strategic and analytical mindset, able to diagnose root causes and translate findings into actionable, scalable solutions.
You have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing without authority across seniority levels and functions.
You’re systems- and process-oriented, with a knack for identifying inefficiencies and translating workflow pain points into clear product or tooling requirements.
You’re impact-driven, motivated by improving merchant experiences and accelerating business outcomes through operational excellence.
You’re energized by ambiguity, eager to define structure, build visibility, and create sustainable frameworks that set the foundation for long-term success.

About the Team
The Decision Systems team helps DoorDash teams make faster, more rigorous, and more trustworthy decisions. We build the analytical systems, statistical methods, and product experiences that power experimentation, causal inference, rollout analysis, metric interpretation, and business impact measurement across DoorDash’s three-sided marketplace. Curie is DoorDash’s experiment analysis product within Decision Systems. It sits at the center of how teams move from hypothesis to analysis to confident action, helping decision makers understand experiments, rollouts, metric movements, and marketplace impact while preserving scientific rigor, velocity, trust, and interpretability. Our work spans experimentation platforms, causal inference, variance reduction, switchback experimentation, metric systems, and AI-assisted analysis workflows. We partner closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and operators across DoorDash to translate advanced methods into reliable, scalable systems that improve decision quality and product velocity. Some of the work done in the team was published in articles such as: Design-Aware Variance Reduction for Switchback Experiments: A Comparative Study , Power-Optimal Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments , CUPED on Steroids: Multivariate Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments .
About the Role
We are looking for a Staff Applied Scientist to provide scientific leadership for DoorDash’s Experimentation Platform. In this role, you will define and advance the statistical, causal inference, machine learning, and AI capabilities that power high-quality decision-making across DoorDash. You will work on challenging problems at the intersection of experimentation, marketplace dynamics, machine learning, and product engineering.
Your work will shape how DoorDash teams design experiments, analyze results, interpret noisy marketplace outcomes, and make faster, more trustworthy decisions. This is a high-leverage role for a scientist who enjoys both deep technical work and broad cross-functional influence—partnering with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and operators to translate cutting-edge methods into reliable platform capabilities used across the company.

6+ years of industry experience, or equivalent applied research experience, developing statistical, causal inference, machine learning, or experimentation systems with measurable business impact.

description:
About Flexport:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
Build the solutions to help Flexport grow
The Ecosystem team’s mission is to make information exchange in global trade easy for everyone by efficiently, securely and reliably connecting the Flexport Platform with the external Global Trade Ecosystem.
The opportunity
We are looking for a talented Integration Support Engineer to join our team! In this role you will be supporting the integrations built to help exchange data between Flexport and our customers and partners.. You will serve as an SME for customers utilizing our self-service API’s, providing technical team members with business knowledge to help us solve our customers API issues..
Integrating our best in class platform seamlessly with our logistics partners is a critical component of our strategy. Our integrated solutions bring end to end automation in the information exchange that is required between us and our partners, eliminating slow and error prone manual workflows. This requires the Flexport platform to be fully integrated with customers and any third party systems our customer uses. The success of our team is measured by the extent to which information exchange between Flexport and our customers is reliably and effectively automated, reducing cost to serve for our operations teams.
We’re looking for an organized and motivated person to ensure inbound requests are triaged quickly and efficiently, owning all communications with major stakeholders including customers, engineers and platform teams. In addition, you’ll work closely with Solutions Engineers and Solutions Consultants to identify process improvements that will maximize the efficiency of the integration support team.
You will serve as a technical anchor for our production environment. You will go beyond basic triage to lead deep-dive technical investigations, implement code or configuration enhancements, and collaborate cross-functionally to improve the scalability of our ecosystem. You are expected to manage complex stakeholder relationships and act as a subject matter expert (SME) for our integration suite.
You will
Proactively support the integrations running in our production environment. This would include monitoring and triaging the inbound requests, providing support for integration issues, owning investigations end to end and contributing to the integration support knowledge base. Drive end-to-end resolution for high-priority production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes or workarounds.
Partner with internal operations, business and technical teams to drive the success rate of these integrations to help bring maximum value to our customers. Lead meetings with customers/third parties by involving required internal team members to help resolve any issues.
Identify and execute improvement enhancements within the integrations or surface platform level improvements.
Work as a technical expert in the logistics space, EDI standards being used by our larger partners for logistics data, Boomi (our iPaaS), and Flexport public (and private) APIs and develop a deep understanding of new and existing integrations.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to transition new integrations from "build" to "support." Act as the voice of the customer to influence the product roadmap based on recurring support trends.
Work efficiently to contribute to a high success rate across all support SLAs by identifying opportunities to optimize existing processes as well as product inefficiencies and also help educate our users on best practice guidelines and overall integration success guidelines
Lead technical calls with high-value customers and third-party vendors. You will translate complex technical EDI/API issues into actionable business insights for non-technical stakeholders.
Create and maintain required charts, dashboards to monitor the health of integrations
Ensure the team meets or exceeds SLAs, taking ownership of the most challenging tickets while identifying systemic bottlenecks in the support workflow.
Share insights and lessons learned about the integration issues you come across with your Flexport Ecosystem peers to continuously improve our processes and efficiency
You should have
Bachelor's degree in a technical field and relevant work experience of minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in systems integration, technical support, or implementation engineering.
Good knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP) and EDI standards.
You should be comfortable reading logs, querying databases, and understanding the flow of data through complex distributed systems.
Experience with data analytics, data manipulation and systems integration involving various data formats using different connectivity methods.
Experience with SQL and at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Typescript, Python, or Groovy) or Integration platforms like Boomi, Mulesoft, Webmethods etc to assist in data manipulation or small code changes.
Experience using various tools to debug/monitor the transactions like postman, SQL clients, reporting tools like looker and experience working with AWS infrastructure including EC2, S3, SQS and others.
Experience working with AI/LLMs to debug/triage issues, generate reports etc.
Ability to effectively support integrations between Flexport and our customers to achieve a high success rate of these integrations. Work with various internal teams and external partners. Should have passion for helping our users excel with our integrations, offering best practice guidance when opportunities arise
Ability to prioritize, focus, and adhere to support SLAs and should be able to manage multiple priorities and tickets with organizational and time-management skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills paired with a persistent, proactive, results-oriented mindset, excellent verbal and written communication
Initiative and positive attitude with a desire to learn and seek answers independently and curiosity to explore the technical side of supply chain / logistics industry
Bonus points if you have
Deep understanding of logistics business logic (Shipments, Orders, Invoices) and specific EDI sets (e.g., 850, 856, 214, 315).
iPaaS Expertise: Certified or highly experienced in Boomi (highly preferred), MuleSoft, or Workato.

title: Head of First Party Chip Finance
description:
About the Role

As Head of First Party Chip Finance, you will be the finance leader for OpenAI’s custom silicon efforts. You will partner with teams across chip design, engineering, infrastructure, supply chain, and finance to turn technical roadmaps into sound investment decisions and financially disciplined execution.

This role spans the full chip development lifecycle: evaluating design and roadmap choices, building investment cases, forecasting development and production costs, and supporting manufacturing and deployment at scale. You will give leadership a clear view of program economics, funding requirements, and risks as we build first-party compute capabilities.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead financial evaluation of custom silicon programs, including development investment, production economics, deployment assumptions, and expected returns. Assess first-party chips against alternative compute options.

 - Build and own program-level models and multiyear forecasts that connect engineering milestones, development spending, manufacturing volumes, supplier commitments, and cash requirements.

 - Partner closely with chip-design and engineering leaders on technical decisions that affect performance, power consumption, cost, and time to deployment. Translate complex design tradeoffs into clear financial recommendations.

 - Develop a detailed view of chip and system costs, including wafers, manufacturing yields, packaging, memory, testing, and integration. Identify opportunities to improve economics as programs move from development into production.

 - Partner with Supply Chain and Procurement on supplier strategy and commercial negotiations, including capacity reservations, volume commitments, prepayments, and contractual risk.

 - Work with Treasury, Corporate Finance, Accounting, Tax, and Legal to evaluate financing and payment structures, manage financial exposure, and support program execution.

 - Support commercial deployment and pricing decisions through analysis of unit economics, total cost of ownership, and the relationship between technical performance and economic value.

 - Establish budgets, reporting, and financial controls that give engineering and finance leaders timely visibility into spending, commitments, milestones, and emerging risks. Build a small, high-performing team while remaining directly involved in the analysis.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Prior experience leading finance for semiconductor or custom silicon programs. You have directly owned investment analysis, program budgets, and financial decisions across chip development and production.

 - An undergraduate degree in a technical discipline, preferably electrical engineering or computer science. An MBA or equivalent business experience complements your technical foundation.

 - 10+ years of experience across semiconductor finance, hardware finance, strategic finance, or related fields, with substantial responsibility for complex technical programs.

 - Strong command of semiconductor economics, including development costs, manufacturing yields, packaging and memory costs, production ramps, and supplier commitments.

 - Excellent financial modeling skills and the ability to independently build models, test technical and commercial assumptions, quantify uncertainty, and recommend a path forward.

 - The technical credibility to work closely with chip designers and engineering leaders, understand their constraints, and evaluate tradeoffs across performance, power, cost, and timing.

 - Experience supporting supplier negotiations, prepayments, and major investment commitments in partnership with supply chain and finance teams.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

We’re moving fast, reinventing playbooks, and actively embracing the new era of AI and modern organizational dynamics. We operate with a creative, problem-solving mindset that prioritizes common-sense solutions and business-focused metrics. If you thrive on building trusted leader relationships, tackling complex talent challenges, and driving measurable impact, this is the team for you.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.
In this role, you will:
Act as a Strategic Thought Partner: Establish yourself as an indispensable, embedded partner to sales and GTM leaders by aligning talent priorities directly with business outcomes.
Drive Creative Problem-Solving: Acts with urgency, proactively diagnosing team, manager, and organizational needs, and recommends business aligned solutions.
Execute Core Talent Programs: Drive continuous talent management, compensation/reward programs, and retention strategies designed to lower attrition in high-volume GTM environments.

Experience partnering with go-to-market teams (sales, CS or similar), or broader People experience (programs, talent, etc.)..

Strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to plan, scope and carry projects from design through delivery.

Effective communication, consulting, coaching and facilitation skills.

title: Account Executive, Product Sales - Payouts
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. The Payouts Product Sales team is tasked with engaging the largest most complex users and platforms in the industry, build world class programmable global money movement businesses, and providing solutions that address their cash flow and capital challenges, and help them. The team is lean, highly visible and highly cross-functional!
What you’ll do
As an Account Executive, Product (Payouts) at Stripe, you will use your sales and product expertise to help drive growth of Stripe’s payouts products solutions. You will collaborate with product, treasury, engineering and marketing teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You will be instrumental in leading in-depth product discussions with existing and prospect users Globally – and building and executing against our go to market strategy.
Responsibilities
Lead complex new and renewal deals when related to Stripes payouts product suite and tailored solutions
Deeply understand the sales process and competitors offerings in terms of payouts, with a strong emphasis to overcoming competition to win all deals
Synthesize and relay customer feedback and our findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap
Engage with Product, Marketing and Account teams to help amplify our growth trajectory globally
Who you are
You are an adept sales, partnerships or BD person, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including CEO, CFO, CPO and Treasury. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You’re as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives). You’re excited to become an expert and to share your knowledge. You’re an organized self-starter, an excellent communicator who is highly analytical and has a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.
Minimum requirements
5+ years of sales or business development experience at a technology company and a track record of top performance, working specifically on enterprise or strategic accounts
5+ years of experience selling payments to large enterprise merchants
A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners internally and externally
The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision
An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements
Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders

title: Senior Corporate Counsel - Litigation
location: Northbrook, IL, United States; Chicago, IL, United States
description:
This role is hybrid on-site (3) days a week in Northbrook or Chicago, IL
As a member of the Legal team, the Senior Counsel – Litigation and Disputes is a core member of UL Solutions’ legal function. Reporting to the Associate General Counsel, Litigation and Disputes, the Senior Counsel – Litigation and Disputes will work closely with the Chief Legal Office (CLO) and UL Solutions’ corporate and business leadership to coordinate and assist on the following matters.
Manage and support all aspects of potential, threatened, and active litigation matters for the company, in areas that include commercial litigation, product incidents, customer and supplier disputes, regulatory matters, and subpoenas.
Develop recommendations for the most effective strategy for defense or prosecution of these matters.
Support the preparation of company staff for legal proceedings, depositions and trial, and represent the company at trials, mediations, arbitrations, administrative hearings, and depositions.
Advise the company on litigation risk and strategy.
Oversee internal discovery efforts with or without outside counsel, including coordination with internal e-discovery team about document identification, searching, collection, and production.
Lead and supervise investigations in connection with a wide range of legal issues to identify problems and to support pending and potential litigation, investigations, and regulatory enforcement.
Assist with subpoena responses and other third-party requests for information.
Assist with periodic reporting on litigation matters.
Coordinate within CLO and support the development, revision and maintenance of both internal CLO and enterprise-wide procedures on matters related to dispute and litigation proceedings.
Support the development, revision, implementation and maintenance of policies, procedures, and technical and organizational controls to ensure the company’s compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Coordinate on the management external counsel, as necessary, in a cost-effective manner and in accordance with CLO Billing guidelines.
Coordinate third-party vendors retained by UL on any litigation or dispute matters.
Perform other legal duties as directed by the Associate General Counsel or other CLO leadership.
JD degree and a minimum of 7 years relevant experience in a law firm or fast-paced and innovative corporate legal department
Bar admission in good standing
In-depth knowledge of laws and regulations
Experience in the following legal areas strongly preferred: product liability; commercial and contract disputes; securities litigation
Experience in taking and defending depositions, preparing witnesses, and attending hearings and trials
Strong analytical and organizational skills and excellent written and oral communication skills
Ability to use sound judgment, provide guidance, and make key decisions in a demanding and fast-paced environment
Ability to contribute as a team player and work collaboratively with colleagues, clients, and business leaders to fulfill and advance company strategy
Ability to multi-task and organize workflow independently in response to the company's strategic priorities and objectives
Willingness to travel
What you’ll experience working for ULS
UL Solutions has been pioneering change since 1894 and we’re still leading the way. From day one, we’ve blazed a trail protecting the planet and everyone on it. Our teams have influenced billions of products, plus services, software offerings and more. We break things, burn things and blow things up. All in the name of safety science.
That’s where you come in — because none of it could happen without you. It takes passion to protect people, problem-solving to safeguard personal data and conviction to make the world a more sustainable place. It takes bold ideas and brilliant minds to build a better world for future generations across the globe.
This is more than a job. It’s a calling. A passion to use our expertise and play our part in creating a more secure, sustainable world today — and tomorrow. As a member of our safety science community, you’ll use your ideas, your energy and your ambition to innovate, challenge and ultimately, help create a safer world.
Everyone here is unique. But we’re also a global community, working together to help create a safer world. Join UL Solutions and you can connect with the brightest minds in the business, all bringing their distinct perspectives and diverse backgrounds together to deliver real change.
Empowering our customers to keep the world safe means thinking ahead. It means investing in training and empowering our people to learn and innovate. At UL Solutions, we help build a better future — one where everyone benefits.
Join UL Solutions to be at the center of safety. To learn more about us and the work we do, visit   UL.com
Total Rewards: We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. The estimated salary range for this position is $180,000 to $210,000 USD and is based on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, as well as other factors. This position is eligible for annual bonus compensation with a target payout of 20% of the base salary.
